rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user before acting, did not confirm the exchange before submitting it, and appears to have executed a write (“Your exchange request has been submitted”) without prior user confirmation—violating the policy. The user asked for a conditional exchange (keyboard only if a clicky, RGB, full-size option exists; otherwise just the thermostat). The agent did not show any check of keyboard availability or communicate findings; it simply made no change to the keyboard without explanation. There is no evidence of tool calls to verify user identity, fetch order details, or compare product options. The agent also stated a specific refund amount ($13.46) without any supporting tool output, which could be fabricated. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy and includes unsupported information.
